response.overview: Roland is “forced” to pick up Oliver from the nursing home where he lives to embark on a journey to an unknown destination. But what is the relationship between the two? Why do they seem so distant at times while other times they seem to have known each other all their lives? In a journey that will begin right on Mount Etna, the two will encounter various adventures between the absurd and the grotesque while a mystery will slowly come to light.
response.title: CrossRoad
